files.desc: Simulating lost and out-of-order packets, and TCP-style resending.
Building routers' forwarding tables with Dijkstra's algorithm, and rerouting after a link fails.

covers.desc: Packets, TCP and UDP, IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, prefixes, NAT, ports, routing as shortest paths (link-state and distance-vector), latency and the speed of light, DNS, and network layers.
